title: Enterprise Connectivity: review unit price selection
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this review unit price selection rule to corrected monthly transfer assessment.

## Basis: unit price
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, read the standard unit price from the original service-interval tier.

## Basis: chosen unit price
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, use signed negotiated unit price only when negotiated-price approval is approved, otherwise use the tier unit price.

## Basis Q&A
**What governs corrected monthly transfer assessment here?** Use signed negotiated unit price only when negotiated-price approval is approved, otherwise use the tier unit price.

## Hypothetical approval choice
Assume a hypothetical signed unit price of USD 0.14 and a tier unit price of USD 0.19. Approved negotiated pricing selects USD 0.14; without that approval, the selection is USD 0.19.
